prompt:
Create a polished face construction sheet for the SAME original 27-year-old adult woman in the reference, on a single landscape canvas with three equal panels: FRONT, three-quarter, and true side profile. No written labels or text. This is a consistency study for an anime game heroine. Preserve her adult face, chestnut asymmetric collarbone bob with outward-flipped ends, amber almond eyes, bold tapering upper lash lines, tiny stylized nose and small closed-mouth smile, charcoal collared shirt with cream inner facing. No accessories. Clear 2D anime style, fine colored contours, crisp cel shadows with subtle cheek warmth, restrained broad hair highlights.

All three portraits are head and shoulders at equal scale. Crucially leave a wide band of empty pale gray ABOVE each hair crown: the portraits occupy only the middle 75% of panel height, with the entire crown and bob silhouette visible. FRONT panel: head upright, no tilt, eye line horizontal, both irises visible through separated side fringe. MIDDLE: head rotated 45 degrees toward viewer left, same hair part and short nose structure, no mirrored bangs. RIGHT: exact 90-degree profile facing viewer left, just one eye visible, anatomically coherent adult forehead/nose/lips/chin silhouette, moderate small nose rather than a long realistic nose, bob wraps naturally around neck. Do not make the profile a different face. Consistent neck thickness, hair length, skin tone and clothing collar. Neutral soft lighting and same pale gray background. No photorealism, no glossy lips, no childish proportions, no props, no hands, no chest emphasis. Favor clear model-sheet structure over a beauty pose.
visual_review: All crowns visible. Adult face, chestnut bob, amber eyes and collar generally consistent across front/three-quarter/profile-like views. Front still slightly tilted; middle not measured 45 degrees; right is near-profile, not certified orthographic. Near eye partly covered by bangs, sides touch panel edges. Useful design study, not final model sheet.
